    Relative cochains of character χ and their coefficients #

    "all cochains are normalized relative to the vertex identities and respect the categorical grading and the integer ray weights." A normalized relative two-cochain of character χ on Λ ≅ kP is Φ₂ of its coefficients (realize); it is a coboundary exactly when its coefficients are d₁ of coefficients (coef_of_isCobdry, isCobdry_of_coef).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RaySys.Sys.coef_left {V R L : Type} [AddCommGroup L] [DecidableEq L] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R] (S : Sys V R L) {χ : L} (k : Type u) [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] (y : ↥(S.P.Lin k)) {u v t₀ : R} (hI : S.I2 χ (u, v)) (ht₀ : S.w2 χ u v = some t₀) :
    ((S.P.basis k).repr (S.P.b k u * y)) t₀ = if S.Shift χ v ∧ (S.P.mul u (S.succ χ v)).isSome = true then ((S.P.basis k).repr y) (S.succ χ v) else 0

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RaySys.Sys.coef_right {V R L : Type} [AddCommGroup L] [DecidableEq L] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R] (S : Sys V R L) {χ : L} (k : Type u) [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] (y : ↥(S.P.Lin k)) {u v t₀ : R} (hI : S.I2 χ (u, v)) (ht₀ : S.w2 χ u v = some t₀) :
    ((S.P.basis k).repr (y * S.P.b k v)) t₀ = if S.Shift χ u ∧ (S.P.mul (S.succ χ u) v).isSome = true then ((S.P.basis k).repr y) (S.succ χ u) else 0

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RaySys.Sys.coef_mid {V R L : Type} [AddCommGroup L] [DecidableEq L] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R] (S : Sys V R L) {χ : L} (k : Type u) [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] (H : ↥(S.P.Lin k) →ₗ[k] ↥(S.P.Lin k)) {u v t₀ : R} (hI : S.I2 χ (u, v)) (ht₀ : S.w2 χ u v = some t₀) :
    ((S.P.basis k).repr (H (S.P.b k u * S.P.b k v))) t₀ = match S.P.mul u v with | some t => if S.Shift χ t then ((S.P.basis k).repr (H (S.P.b k t))) (S.succ χ t) else 0 | none => 0
